$Comment: Festival Favor: the name, picture and ranks of the game's reputation group of the same id
(NPC/Reputation/Groups/Seasons_Of_Orbis_Festival.json), a reputation with no characters in it.
It climbs the seven shared ranks like any reputation, then keeps going. Each Ranks entry with a
From is a rank of this reputation's own that starts at that much earned favor; every From sits
above Exalted's floor, so the shared ranks keep theirs. Name is the rank's name, a key in
seasonsoforbis.lang, and a lock on one of these ranks reads that name with the reputation's.
No Cap, so favor keeps climbing. Beyond pays its Rewards each time earned favor passes another
multiple of Every above the last rank's floor: here festival tokens.
Favor comes from the Reputation rewards on every season's quests and board jobs and on the
Seasons of Orbis ladder, so each quest card says how much. Order 5 puts it above the seasons'
own reputations on the Reputation page.
